summary: Verified the Outbound Human-Greeting Gate (Phases A-E). All 9 contract tests + classifier unit test in /app/backend/tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py pass. Live HTTP smoke checks against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirm the 9 hard rules hold: /answer redirects silently for humans and hangs up silently for AMD machine_*; /greeting emits a silent <Gather input='speech' speechTimeout='auto'> with no Say/Play children; /api/tts/audio/{id} returns 404 for unknown ids; legacy /api/twilio/inbound* endpoints remain reachable (200). Mount log 'Mounted Outbound Human-Greeting Gate at /api/twilio/outbound/*' is present in backend supervisor logs. server.py mount block (lines 13230-13257) is additive and does not modify legacy routes.

minor.issue: backend_url=MISSING in mount log because neither BACKEND_URL nor REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is set in /app/backend/.env. <Play> URLs are still served correctly as relative paths (Twilio resolves against webhook host) and the gate works, but setting BACKEND_URL would emit absolute URLs and make TwiML self-contained.

live_smoke_checks.POST /api/twilio/outbound/greeting?sessi: 200 — <Gather action='/api/twilio/outbound/respond?...' input='speech' method='POST' speechTimeout='auto' timeout='8'/><Hangup/>. No Say/Play children inside Gather. PASS

action_items: OPTIONAL: Set BACKEND_URL (or rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) in /app/backend/.env so the outbound mount log shows backend_url=set and <Play> URLs emit as absolute URLs. Non-blocking — TwiML works with relative paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Mount block in server.py is correctly additive (try/except wrapped, placed after app.include_router(api_router)). It does NOT touch legacy inbound routes — confirmed.
Outbound router enforces ElevenLabs <Play> for AI voice and Twilio <Say> is absent from /answer, /greeting, and /respond responses (verified by both XML assertions in pytest and curl smoke tests).
DNC gating happens in place_outbound_call BEFORE any twilio_client.create() or eleven_client.synthesize() invocation (test_9 confirms zero side-effects on DNC).

Backend server (server.py) is now ~13.3k lines — well past the 700-line guideline. The new outbound logic was correctly placed in /app/backend/routes/twilio_outbound.py (good), but the legacy monolith is still a maintainability risk. Out of scope for this fix.
Minor: backend_url falls back to empty string when env vars missing — consider failing loudly at startup in production-only mode if absolute URLs are required for cross-region Twilio media fetch.
seed_data_creation: none — tests use mongomock_motor in-memory DB; live smoke tests used session_id=nonexistent (graceful path)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Outbound Human-Greeting Gate ships clean. Regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py is the contract — run `cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_twilio_outbound_gate.py -v`. Pre-existing failure in tests/universal/test_campaign_session.py::test_control_opener_matches_brian_wording is unrelated and OUT OF SCOPE.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — feature verification, not bug RCA. The previous P0 (dialer speaking before human, falling back to Twilio <Say>) is structurally prevented by: (a) place_outbound_call sends url= callback, never inline twiml; (b) /answer never emits Say/Play and only Redirects to /greeting on human or Hangs up on machine_*; (c) /greeting emits a silent <Gather> with no audio children; (d) only after human SpeechResult does /respond render <Play>/api/tts/audio/{id}; (e) DNC check short-circuits before any Twilio/ElevenLabs API call.
